svg.text: “A successful infrastructure command does not mean the service recovered.”
in-memory only — no external persistence layer
No database, queue or cache — state resets when the
unique run_id · explicit goal per run
Goal: Restore the service to configured SLOs while respecting safety constraints.
closed control loop — bounded to 3 attempts per run
Tool-based retrieval from the live environment
deterministic fallback if advisory is unavailable
AI proposals validated against operational evidence
same telemetry contract as Kubernetes mode
local cluster — not a production control plane
Inputs: multiple fresh samples · health check · capacity · ready replicas
Recovery SLO: error rate ≤ 5% · latency ≤ 200 ms · health check passes
Attempt 2 comes from fresh evidence — not from the attempt number.
